ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 2.3:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains high-density vertical dark bands originating from the outer margins. Right lobe is predominantly high-intensity white with isolated dark vertical linear streaks and one distinct dark elliptical spot at the distal-posterior quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 48 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.18 relative to the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with amplitude peaks up to 12 pixels; notable deep indentations at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic curves fitted from the median notch extending to the distal tips of the fluke.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white geometric artifacts with irregular 3D topography localized at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular high-intensity spots on the left lobe medial surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel, near-vertical low-intensity linear segments localized in the medial region of the right lobe and the lower ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark circular pixel cluster (void-like) on the right lobe near the trailing edge tip; significant structural protrusion on the distal left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Single isolated high-contrast dark elliptical mark (eye-like) in the upper right quadrant of the right lobe.
